test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 20 Sept 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Rohini walked for 2 kilometres on a straight road, facing North. Then she took a right turn and walked for 1 kilometre. Then she again took a right turn and walked 2 kilometres. In which direction is she facing now? (All turns are 90 degree turns only)
solution:
From the given information:**
Step 1: Rohini walked for 2 kilometres on a straight road, facing North.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/814bb2467521282fad7b6d4604c9008240d84cdf5078587a8948c68a72f6e025.png] 

Step 2: Then she took a right turn and walked for 1 kilometre.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1ba4375fa3b21c66a96f2cf25dfec2be84a9182bf6bdf66848a847550a3d3191.png] 

Step 3: Then she again took a right turn and walked 2 kilometres.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/13ede0b42b88cbb35af6b5f6c8505d544fbf1c19e9974f451e49d3671de42fe1.png] 

From the diagram we can see that **Rohini is facing towards south.**

Hence the correct answer is " South ".**
